description:
Web Analytics by PaidSync.ai reports on the Google Analytics 4 properties you own, when you ask ChatGPT in plain language.

What you can do:
- Run reports on sessions, users, traffic sources, pages and key events for the dates you choose.
- Review properties, data streams, key events and linked ad accounts.
- See which dimensions and metrics a property offers.

How it works:
Sign in with your PaidSync.ai account, then connect each platform through that platform's own sign-in screen; PaidSync never asks for a platform password in chat. ChatGPT names the account, property or container to read on each question where the tool takes one, or reads the account selected in PaidSync. This app only reads: it changes nothing in your ad accounts, properties or containers.

PaidSync.ai is independent and is not made or endorsed by Google, Meta, Microsoft or the other platforms it connects. Security details: https://paidsync.ai/security

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1. App icon only: the new PaidSync.ai knot symbol replaces the old PS icon. No change to text, tools, server address or sign-in.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns each property with its id, name, time zone and currency. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: Show sessions and users by traffic source for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns sessions and users per source and medium for the period. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: Which pages had the most views last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns pages sorted by views for last week. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: List the key events set up in my analytics property.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the key events with their names and creation dates. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: What data streams does my analytics property have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each data stream with its type, name and measurement id. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

negative.description: A change to a property: this app only reads, so it should not run.
negative.prompt: Create a new key event called purchase_complete.

negative.description: Ad spend, which this app does not cover.
negative.prompt: How much did I spend on Google Ads yesterday?
